_comment_purpose: Debian package metadata for the Linux .deb installer (T-L7-01). Consumed by electron-builder via `linux.deb` + the per-target `deb` block in electron-builder.yml. Mirrors the Debian Policy Manual fields commonly needed by .deb consumers.
_comment_status: Stable for MVP-1. T-L7-04 release workflow may extend `recommends` once auxiliary integrations (e.g. desktop notifications, system tray) gain hard dependencies.
synopsis: Local-first, methodology-driven workspace UI for Sherpa
description: Sherpa UI Client is a local-first Electron application that provides a methodology-driven workspace on top of the Sherpa CLI. The installer ships a bundled `sherpa` CLI binary at /opt/Sherpa UI Client/resources/bin/sherpa per ADR-006 (sub-decision: bundled CLI). All project data and methodology content remain under the user's HOME directory; no cloud telemetry.
